description:
Adventist pastor and apologist, Ivor Myers, from Power of the Lamb Ministries (@powerofthelamb), recently put out a "bombshell" scapegoat challenge where he played a couple of clips from things stated on this platform regarding the Leviticus 16 Day of Atonement scapegoat picturing Jesus Christ over and against Satan. We take him up on his challenge, examine if it's anything new that the SDA Church hasn't been trying to claim for 180 years and point out a number of biblical inconsistencies along the way—issuing our own challenge to Mr. Myers and Adventists that agree with him.

Video in review: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OcCGcaJAq6c
